architectureDecisions: D1 — Original-versus-materialized digests. Use delivered canonicalJson (packages/agent-tools/src/run-trace.js: sorted keys, undefined dropped). taskDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({id, repositoryRoot: resolve(repositoryRoot), baseRevision, prompt, verifications: [{name, command, args, timeoutMs}], requiredFiles: requiredFiles ?? []})) over the validateAgentTask original, never over strategyTask. declaredContextDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({taskId, baseRevision, requiredFiles: requiredFiles ?? [], maxMaterializedBytes})). materializedContextDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({items: items.map(({path, sourceRef, snapshotRef, contentSha256}), promptPrefixDigest)})) from resolveAgentTaskContext; when agentContext is null or used:false use {items: [], promptPrefixDigest: sha256('')}. executionDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({model: model ?? null, permissionProfile, maxAttempts, maxFeedbackChars, timeoutMs, toolVersion, envKeys: Object.keys(env ?? {}).sort()})). Never hash env values. DELIVERED_TRUTH: runSupervisedTask builds strategyTask = agentContext?.used === true ? { ...task, prompt: `${agentContext.promptPrefix}\n\n${task.prompt}` } : task and passes strategyTask into runRecoverableTask, so persist today cannot bind the original prompt. Pass original `task` plus `strategyTask` plus `agentContext` into runRecoverableTask; persist digests from original task; dispatch still uses strategyTask.

D2 — V2 handle, BOUND phase, persist-before-dispatch. Export AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V2; AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_VERSION becomes that string. HandlePhase gains BOUND. V2 createAgentToolRunHandle/assertHandleBody require taskDigest, declaredContextDigest, materializedContextDigest, executionDigest as 64-hex and include them in handleDigest. V1 reads still validate the current V1 field set (no digest fields). After workspace/session/toolVersion probe and before harness.start/vary, persist a BOUND handle: status RUNNING, candidateSha=baseRevision, toolSessionRef=null, attemptIndex=1, feedback="". onActCompleted/onAttemptCompleted and terminal persist then refresh as today. DELIVERED_TRUTH: the first persist is inside onActCompleted after the first ACT returns; HandlePhase allows only ACT_COMPLETED|ATTEMPT_COMPLETED; a crash before first ACT leaves no handle.

D3 — Resume revalidation before side effects. resumeSupervisedTask gains repositoryReader, maxMaterializedBytes, snapshotObserve (same defaults as runSupervisedTask). Order before reopenRecoverableWorkspace or any child: verifyAgentToolRunHandle -> disk digest (else STALE_HANDLE) -> HANDLE_COMPLETE -> TOOL_MISMATCH -> version V1 or missing digest fields throws LEGACY_HANDLE -> validateAgentTask(rawTask) required -> recompute taskDigest/declaredContextDigest/executionDigest from the resupplied original task and the resolved launch params (model??null, permissionProfile, resolvedMaxAttempts, maxFeedbackChars, timeoutMs, probed toolVersion, env key set) -> re-run resolveAgentTaskContext at the pinned baseRevision under the bound maxMaterializedBytes and recompute materializedContextDigest -> any mismatch throws RecoveryError CONTRACT_DRIFT -> SOURCE_HEAD_DRIFT -> reopenRecoverableWorkspace. Then rebuild strategyTask with the identical promptPrefix so resume dispatches the byte-identical materialized prompt. DELIVERED_TRUTH: resume currently reopens the worktree before the id/repo/base check, compares only those three fields, drops the promptPrefix, and takes model/permissionProfile/timeoutMs/maxFeedbackChars/env from the resume call without binding.

D4 — Configurable-limit policy is exact equality, fail-closed. model, permissionProfile, maxAttempts, maxFeedbackChars, timeoutMs, maxMaterializedBytes, toolVersion and the env key set must match the bound digests; any change is CONTRACT_DRIFT, never a silent upgrade. Credential value rotation is out-of-band and is not drift because values are not hashed. Unchanged V2 resume retains the same worktree (reopenRecoverableWorkspace, no second git worktree add), the same Core session (createFileSessionStore over recoveryDir/core-session, sessionId agent-task:<id>, harness.recover(sessionId, {force: true}), never harness.start) and the same tool session (initialSessionRef: handle.toolSessionRef). BOUND resume: startAttempt=1, skipFirstAct=false, initialSessionRef=null.

D5 — Legacy fail-closed, no manufactured identity. AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 (or a handle missing the four digests) throws RecoveryError LEGACY_HANDLE with message 'AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 predates exact contract binding: dispose the legacy handle (disposeRecoverableRun) and re-dispatch via runSupervisedTask to mint a V2 binding; never backfill binding fields onto a legacy handle.' deliver-slice maps LEGACY_HANDLE to disposeRecoveryQuietly plus slice reason LEGACY_HANDLE and does not call resumeSupervisedTask. assertSliceHandleIdentity stays as the id/repo/base pre-check; CONTRACT_DRIFT and LEGACY_HANDLE from resume still apply. Do not write digest fields onto a V1 body.

D6 — Tests in packages/agent-tools/test/recovery-contract-binding.test.js. Titles: 'BB-125 N1 Same id with changed verifier must be rejected before any verification' (resumeSupervisedTask, CONTRACT_DRIFT, no verifier spawn), 'BB-125 N2 Same id with changed prompt must be rejected before dispatch' (CONTRACT_DRIFT before reopen/spawn), 'BB-125 N3 Legacy handle cannot acquire a self-asserted contract binding' (V1 handle -> LEGACY_HANDLE; writing digest fields onto it is not accepted). Positive: onHandleWrite first sees phase BOUND before any ACT; unchanged crash-supervised.mjs resume retains worktreeRoot, coreSessionId and toolSessionRef. Hermetic fake CLI; no network, no credentials, no real agent CLIs. Existing recovery.test.js RC1–RC5 remain the BB-101 contract.

D7 — Executed evidence (discovery.json at baseline 5386e2ad, providerCalls 0): sameIdChangedPromptAndVerifierAccepted true, status ACCEPTED, candidateStillSubtracts true, handleHasTaskDigest false. Source: resume identity check is id/repositoryRoot/baseRevision only; handle body has no prompt/verifications/model/permissionProfile; first persist is onActCompleted; strategyTask (materialized prompt) is what runRecoverableTask receives.

D8 — Living docs: docs/living/system/agent-tools/recovery.md describes V2 four digests, BOUND persist-before-dispatch, CONTRACT_DRIFT before reopen, LEGACY_HANDLE with the migration sentence, and original-versus-materialized prompt. Keep the string AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 as the legacy name so RC5 still matches. docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md keeps the recovery.md pointer. No Blackboard ids.
